age.evidence: Young (4 -5 month-old) and old (11 -13 month old) C57BL/6 male mice

sex.evidence: Young (4 -5 month-old) and old (11 -13 month old) C57BL/6 male mice

dosing.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT (sigma) was first dissolved in DMSO and then in 0.9% saline (1:500) to a final dose of 20 mg/kg and injected I.P. 7 days before the re-exposed to open field test

group_housing.evidence: Mice were individually housed after surgeries

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were housed on a 12 h/ 12 h day/night cycle to maintain their normal biorhythms; direction not specified

assays.assay_description: Rectangular open field arena (40 cm × 32 cm × 15 cm) made of opaque white plastic; 10-min sessions. Total distance travelled and time spent in the center were quantified. Tested 1 h after saline/salicylate injection; in the DMT arm, 5-MeO-DMT was given 4-7 days before re-exposure to OFT followed by salicylate.

application_type.evidence: injected I.P. 7 days before the re-exposed to open field test

setup_restrain.evidence: placed individually in the center of the open field

time_to_assay.evidence: The animals treated with DMT four days prior to the test showed increase locomotion after salicylate administration; methods state '7 days before the re-exposed to open field test'

sample_size.evidence: young mice ( n = 8) after salicylate injection

outcomes.summary: A single 20 mg/kg i.p. dose of 5-MeO-DMT given ~4-7 days before testing reversed salicylate-induced anxiety in young male mice, increasing total distance travelled (~22.5 m → ~40.0 m) and time spent in the center (~69 s → ~120 s) compared to salicylate-only animals.
outcomes.evidence: The animals treated with DMT four days prior to the test showed increase locomotion after salicylate administration ... p = .04 ... Pre-treatment with DMT also caused the animals to spend more time in the center of the arena ... p = .001

B1_num_measures.evidence: The following behaviors were quantified: total distance travelled, and time spent in the center of the arena

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: reported as total over the 10-min session

B5_social.evidence: placed individually in the open field

B7_automated_classification.evidence: custom Matlab program used for tracking the animal by thresholding (position only)

E1_environment_type.evidence: rectangular open field arena (40 cm × 32 cm × 15 cm) made of opaque white plastic

E3_bedding.evidence: opaque white plastic floor, cleaned with water

D1_continuity.evidence: Two sessions of ten minutes each were recorded ... second session 1 week following the first; additional re-exposure 4 weeks later for DMT

D2_session_duration.evidence: Two sessions of ten minutes each were recorded

D3_recording_days.evidence: second session 1 week following the first; re-exposed to open field test 4 weeks after the first open field experiment

D4_baseline.evidence: no pre-drug baseline OFT recorded before DMT administration in same animals reported as baseline

D5_followup.evidence: animals treated with DMT four days prior to the test (≥24 h after dose)

assays.assay_description: EPM with four arms (6.5 × 62 cm), two open and two closed (20 cm walls), elevated 52 cm above the floor. Animals were placed in the center and allowed to explore for 10 min; time in open vs closed arms quantified along with LFP recordings. Salicylate injected 1 h before the test.

application_type.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT ... injected I.P.; salicylate i.p. injection 1 h prior to the experiments

setup_restrain.evidence: placed individually in the center of the EPM and allowed to explore the maze for 10 min

time_to_assay.evidence: the mice received salicylate injection 1 h before the test

sample_size.evidence: Salicylate injected young mice ( n = 6) ... old mice (n = 6) treated with salicylate

outcomes.summary: Salicylate-treated young mice spent significantly less time in the open arms vs closed arms, consistent with anxiety-like behavior, while old salicylate-treated mice showed no significant difference between open and closed arms. Theta2 was higher in closed arms and slow gamma higher in open arms in young salicylate mice.
outcomes.statistics: young open vs closed time p = .001; old open vs closed time p = .42
outcomes.evidence: Salicylate injected young mice ( n =6) spend significantly less time in the open arms (117 ± 55, 8s) compared in the close arms (459 ± 73.8s), p = .001

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total time in the open or closed arms and exploration patterns were quantified

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: reported as totals over the 10-min test

B4_ethological.evidence: zone preference time, not ethological behaviors

B7_automated_classification.evidence: custom Matlab tracking by thresholding (position only)

E1_environment_type.evidence: elevated plus maze with four arms (6.5 × 62 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are not a fully enclosed refuge

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are extensions of a central platform, not distinct enclosed compartments

E7_social_context.evidence: placed individually in the center of the EPM

D1_continuity.evidence: each animal were exposure only once to the EPM

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to explored the maze for 10 min

D5_followup.evidence: salicylate given 1 h before test; no ≥24 h post-drug recording in EPM

judge_notes: All candidates included only the OFT; however, the paper explicitly performs an EPM with behavioral quantification (time in open/closed arms) in salicylate-treated young and old mice. Added the EPM as a separate assay.

Per rubric, OFT under different conditions (saline vs salicylate vs salicylate+DMT, young vs old vs noise-trauma) is one assay with multiple recording days; D1=Multiple discrete sessions, D3=2-7 days.
Vehicle for 5-MeO-DMT: dissolved in DMSO then diluted 1:500 in saline; primary solvent recorded as saline with DMSO additive noted.
day_night_flipped scored not_reported (medium) because the paper states 12:12 cycle and recordings done 'during the night' without specifying reversed lighting.
Sex: only male subjects; no per-sex n breakdown provided at the study level.
